label: Air conditioner (split or window)

questions.text: On a typical summer day, how long does the AC run?
questions.why: Long daily running wears parts faster and makes filter cleaning more important.

questions.text: How often are the filters cleaned?
questions.why: Dirty filters make the AC work harder and cool less.

questions.text: Does the power at home often dip, flicker or trip?
questions.why: Unsteady power is a common cause of damage to the electronics and the compressor.

questions.text: Is the AC connected through a voltage stabilizer?
questions.why: A stabilizer helps when the supply is unsteady (some inverter ACs have their own protection).

questions.text: Where is the outdoor unit placed?
questions.why: An outdoor unit in direct sun or a closed space cannot release heat well.

answers.label: In a closed or cramped space

questions.text: When did the AC last have a service visit?
questions.why: Regular service catches gas leaks and drain problems early.

questions.text: Have you noticed water dripping indoors, weak cooling or unusual noise?
questions.why: These are early signs that the AC needs a check.

care_tips.text: Switch off the AC at the wall before cleaning the filters.
care_tips.why: Cleaning with the power on risks an electric shock.

care_tips.text: Don't open the indoor or outdoor unit yourself; leave repairs to the brand's service technicians.
care_tips.why: The units carry high voltage and pressurised refrigerant.

care_tips.text: Clean the filters regularly, more often when the AC runs many hours a day.
care_tips.why: Clean filters keep the air flowing and the cooling strong.

care_tips.text: Use a voltage stabilizer of the right rating if the power at home is unsteady.
care_tips.why: Voltage swings can damage the electronics and the compressor.

care_tips.text: Keep space around the outdoor unit clear and, if possible, shade it from direct sun.
care_tips.why: The outdoor unit needs to release heat; blocked or sun-baked units work harder.

care_tips.text: Book a service visit with the brand's authorised service before the summer.
care_tips.why: A service catches gas leaks, drain blockages and dirty coils early.

care_tips.text: If water drips indoors, cooling gets weak or you hear new noises, switch the AC off and contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: Running it with a fault can turn a small problem into a bigger one.

care_tips.text: Set a moderate temperature rather than the lowest setting.
care_tips.why: Very low settings keep the compressor running for longer.

reminders.text: Clean the AC filters (switch off at the wall first).
reminders.interval_text: about every 2 weeks while in regular use
reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.
Check your manual and warranty card for the recommended service schedule.
